independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

notes: subject: the objective is 'describe the weather and name the seasons where I live', but neither the teach text nor any item mentions seasons; add teaching and at least one item on the seasons (and weather associated with them).

subject: the teach text 'الطقس يتغير كل يوم' (weather changes every day) is overstated; weather can stay the same for several days. Say it can change from day to day (e.g. 'قد يتغير الطقس من يوم إلى يوم').

claims.claim: Young children describe local weather with words such as sunny, rainy, windy and snowy, and connect weather with what to wear.
